name: bandit.signal_persistence_reentry_001
description: Focused same-world persistence verification from the exact native signal save. All inherited actors, signal observations and leads are zero-credit setup; this run proves only its own native source transition and the exact lead state across a fresh save, process exit and reload.

requirements.fixture: exact native saved-world snapshot; inherited state is zero-credit

setup_classification.reason: Same-world persistence boundary only. The inherited world, actors, source, original clue and distinct returned smoke/light leads are zero-credit setup from a diagnostic bootstrap; this continuation does not replay or claim scouting, observation or return behavior.

steps.label: load_exact_saved_signal_snapshot
steps.expected_visible_fact: Fresh isolated profile signal-persistence-reentry-001 installs the exact native saved TestSetup00 snapshot; inherited source, original clue and returned report records remain zero-credit setup.

steps.label: verify_inherited_signal_state_and_change_source
steps.objective: Use the exact saved-world snapshot as zero-credit inherited footing. Before input, read the same world/player and capture the original camp smoke clue ID, source key, source sample, last_seen and last_checked plus the distinct returned smoke/light report IDs, keys, origins and clocks. Do not re-run discovery, scout dispatch, observation, return or source qualification. If the inherited lighter and brazier fuel are present and native controls allow, natively relight the existing brazier, capture its before/after source fields at the actual game minute, then natively extinguish it and capture the second before/after source fields and actual minute. Add no source, item, time, signal or actor by debug/setup. If native source change is unavailable, record the concrete missing current control or item and continue the persistence check, leaving source-change proof unclaimed. Preserve the inherited clue/report state, perform the required native save/quit and exit through the main-menu quit path.
proof_targets: current source-bound product and fresh isolated profile
exact saved-world source path and installed-world identity with no fixture reinstall
zero-credit inherited source, actor, original clue and separate smoke/light report records
baseline exact original and report lead identities, origins, source keys/samples and clocks
ordinary native relight/extinguish of the existing brazier, if available, with accepted receipts and actual before/after game time and source fields
fresh native save completion and exact saved world/turn after the new source interaction
invariants: all inherited world, party, source, observations, reports and clocks are zero-credit setup
do not replay discovery, dispatch, scouting, observation or physical return
do not inject signal, clue, report, observation, member, route, source, time or support
do not teleport or use avatar/debug setup after snapshot installation
perform source changes only through currently advertised native actions and existing ordinary lighter/fuel
do not infer bubble-edge timing from this persistence check
record an unavailable source-change prerequisite honestly without abandoning the persistence comparison

steps.label: save_and_exit_native_signal_continuation
steps.objective: After baseline comparison and any ordinary native source interaction, save the same disposable continuation world and exit through native main-menu quit. Record exact save success and turn.

evidence_contract.claim: In a new native run, inherited signal/report records are explicitly zero-credit setup. After an ordinary native save and process exit, a fresh process loading the same saved world preserves the exact original signal clue and distinct report-origin lead identities, source/origin fields and independent clocks. An optional ordinary native source change is separately timed from its accepted pre/post receipts.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No fresh native save completion, no exact process exit/reload, changed or conflated lead identities/origins/clocks, source mismatch, fixture reinstall, injected or replayed observation/return, or unresolved process/build/profile binding leaves persistence unproved. A missing ordinary source tool/fuel leaves only the optional source-change boundary unproved.

proof_gates.label: New proof-bearing continuation reaches one worker-controlled same-save live session

steps.label: load_saved_signal_continuation_after_exit
steps.expected_visible_fact: A new process loads the same native saved world with no fixture reinstall; the source state and saved lead records match the fresh save boundary.

steps.label: verify_signal_state_after_reload
steps.objective: Read the reloaded native world at its current minute without advancing time. Compare the original smoke clue and separate structural smoke/light report leads to the pre-save baseline and fresh native save receipt: exact IDs, source keys/origins/samples, last_seen, last_checked and outcomes. Confirm the brazier/source fields match the post-interaction saved state. Do not alter leads, actors, source, time or world state. Close natively and verify exact process exit.
proof_targets: new process generation and same source-world identity
exact original clue ID, source key/sample and independent last_seen/last_checked match the pre-save state
exact distinct smoke and light report IDs, source keys and observation clocks match the pre-save state
source fields match the post-interaction save where the optional interaction was available
second native process exit and bridge/launcher lifecycle closure
invariants: reload the exact confirmed native save without fixture reinstall
no added time or mutations during comparison
do not repeat scouting or infer its attribution from the inherited state
do not infer any loaded-bubble-edge transition

steps.label: close_reloaded_signal_world
steps.objective: Exit the reloaded native World through Save and Quit and the main-menu quit, then verify process exit.
